name: Server Health Anomaly Monitor
prompt:
"Build a 'Server Health & Anomaly Monitor'. The data source is a log file with columns: Timestamp, Service Name, Response Time (ms), and Status Code (e.g., 200, 404, 500).

The app needs to feature:

A time-series line chart tracking Response Time over the course of the day.

An 'Incident Feed' component. If any row has a status code starting with '5' OR a response time exceeding 800ms, it must instantly appear in this feed with a blinking red critical status indicator.

A button to 'Clear Resolved Incidents' that filters those specific flagged items out of the current view without deleting the raw data."

thought_process.interpretation: I am acting as an Expert React Developer building a real-time server monitoring dashboard. The goal is to provide a high-fidelity 'Server Health & Anomaly Monitor' that allows operators to visualize latency trends and manage critical incidents based on status codes and response time thresholds.
assumed_from_scratch: A synthetic log generator creating 200 entries across multiple microservices
A 'Service Name' list (Auth, Gateway, DB, Cache)
Blinking 'Critical' animation using Tailwind arbitrary values
Resolved status tracking system using unique IDs
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Future enhancements could include 'Service Specific' filtering, an 'Export Logs' button, and a 'Threshold Configurator' to change the 800ms limit dynamically.
